prices.title: Price competitiveness
prices.description: See where each live listing's price sits against the typical range buyers see, based on anonymised quotes and orders.
prices.disabledTitle: Price intelligence is not available yet
prices.disabledDescription: We will let you know as soon as benchmarks are ready.
prices.lockedTitle: Price intelligence is part of paid plans
prices.lockedDescription: Upgrade to compare every listing with the typical price range in your state and see how it is trending.
prices.emptyDescription: Publish a listing with a price and unit to compare it with the market.
prices.tableCaption: Your listings compared with the typical price range
prices.basis: Indicative only. Benchmarks use anonymised quotes and escrow orders and are published only when enough different buyers and sellers are involved.
